dependencies.name: Clipper2
patches: clipper.triangulation.cpp/.h: exact SegsIntersect (shared end-point check from upstream 6a36be1c8b) and hard work bounds in Triangulate (D-042); see third_party/clipper2/PATCHES.md

dependencies.name: Manifold
dependencies.source: third_party/manifold (see its README.md; no bindings, TBB or downloads)

dependencies.name: IfcOpenShell
dependencies.linkage: dynamic (private): linked only by sketchyup-ifc-worker, installed in /usr/lib/sketchyup; built when SKETCHYUP_BUILD_IFC is ON
dependencies.source: third_party/ifcopenshell (trimmed upstream tag, see its README.sketchyup.md)

dependencies.name: OpenCASCADE Technology
dependencies.linkage: dynamic (private copy): the libTK* libraries the IfcOpenShell kernel plugin records, copied from Arch's opencascade package at package-build time into /usr/lib/sketchyup
dependencies.source: Arch opencascade package and upstream tag V7_9_3 (see third_party/ifcopenshell/IFC-SOURCE.txt)

dependencies.name: Boost
dependencies.linkage: dynamic: headers at build time, boost-libs at run time (sketchyup-ifc only)

dependencies.name: OpenSKP
dependencies.linkage: static (vendored parser subset, linked only by sketchyup-skp-worker, installed in /usr/lib/sketchyup); the application and sketchyup-cli do not link it
dependencies.source: third_party/openskp (parser subset of the pinned commit, see third_party/openskp/SKP-SOURCE.txt)

dependencies.name: miniz
dependencies.linkage: static (ZIP reader of the vendored OpenSKP, linked only by sketchyup-skp-worker); the inflater alone (miniz_tinfl.c, sketchyup_tinfl) is linked into sketchyup_io for the GeoTIFF reader (R107.b1, ADR 0181 section 7.2)

dependencies.name: Poly Haven CC0 textures
dependencies.linkage: embedded resource: nine JPEGs under resources/textures, compiled into sketchyup_io (no runtime dependency)
dependencies.source: Poly Haven 1K diffuse JPEGs (per-asset pages checked 2026-10-27), resized to 512 px, see third_party/textures/PolyHaven-CC0.txt

dependencies.name: OpenGL
dependencies.source: system Mesa or supported vendor driver
